title: Why-it-moved allow-list (config/news_sources.json)
description: The only web hosts a why-it-moved note may link to (scripts/record_why.py and lint check every source URL). A host matches itself and its subdomains. Each source says whether our research tools can search it and open its pages (checked on reach_checked); hosts the search tool refuses are listed under blocked, never searched and never cited. Owner-editable.

reach_checked.description: When search and opens were last checked with the research tools (WebSearch with allowed_domains, WebFetch on a recent page).

rules.description: Plain rules for the researcher, shown on the site with the list.

host.description: Registrable host without www.; subdomains match (investor.example.com matches example.com).

kind.description: regulator, agency (a public or intergovernmental body that publishes official data, such as EIA, BLS or OPEC), exchange, company and newswire are official sources; outlet and trade are reputable news outlets and trade publications.

search.description: true: WebSearch accepts this host in allowed_domains. The researchers search only these hosts; one host that refuses makes the whole search call fail.

opens.description: false: its pages refused to open for WebFetch when checked (an error, a bot check or a paywall). It may still be cited if a page opens; otherwise look for the same story on a listed host that opens. Never a workaround.

note.description: What to watch for on this host (for example which bylines to cite).

blocked.description: Hosts our research tools cannot use at all (search refuses them; the pages tried did not open either), kept here so the owner sees why they are not in sources. Never searched, never opened, never cited.

host.description: Registrable host without www.; subdomains match (investor.example.com matches example.com).
